errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis categories (layers 1-24) are arranged in alphabetical order. They are arranged in numerical order.

errors.text_span: най-високият стълб е за слой 1 и съдържа около 10 експерта от група G2
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bar for layer 1 contains about 10 experts from group G2. The total number of experts for layer 1 is 10, but the number of experts from group G2 (the yellow segment) is 5.

errors.text_span: най-ниските стълби са за слой 7 и съдържат около 3 експерта от група G2
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bar for layer 7 contains about 3 experts from group G2. The total number of experts for layer 7 is 3, but the number of experts from group G2 (the yellow segment) is 1.

errors.text_span: най-високите стълби са за слоевете 1, 4 и 5
errors.evidence: The description identifies layers 1, 4, and 5 as having the tallest bars, but omits layer 2, which has a total of 8 experts, the same as layer 5.

errors.text_span: най-ниските стълби са за слоевете 7, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 23 и 24
errors.evidence: The description lists layers 23 and 24 among the shortest bars. However, layers 23 and 24 have a height of 4, while the other layers listed (7, 11-17) are shorter, with a height of 3.

errors.text_span: Въз основа на визуалната информация, най-високите стълби са за слоевете 1, 4 и 5, като най-високият стълб е за слой 1 и съдържа около 10 експерта от група G2, а най-ниските стълби са за слоевете 7, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 23 и 24, като най-ниските стълби са за слой 7 и съдържат около 3 експерта от група G2.
errors.evidence: This entire sentence is an exact duplicate of the preceding sentence, which makes the description unnecessarily repetitive and hard to read.

errors.text_span: titled “Less, but Better Efficient Multilingual Expansion for LLMs via Layer-wise Mixture-of-Experts,”
errors.evidence: The figure does not have a title. The description fabricates a title based on the title of the paper it was extracted from.
The color used to represent the G2 category is yellow, not orange.
The legend and bars indicate that the color for G2 is yellow, not orange.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind gruppiert und stapelbar angeordnet
errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart, not a grouped bar chart. There is only one bar for each category on the x-axis, which is internally stacked. The term 'gruppiert' (grouped) is incorrect.

errors.text_span: Der niedrigste Balken befindet sich bei Schicht 7
errors.evidence: While the bar at layer 7 is one of the lowest with a height of 3, it is not the only one. Layers 11 through 17 also have the same minimum height of 3. The statement implies uniqueness which is incorrect.
